Five-star service or "gangster" culture?!
Sep 2026 • Family
National Day holiday - 01/9/2026. My wife and I brought our grandson, as usual, to the pool at Caravell Hotel. Our excitement was instantly chilled by the employee named Linh glancing at the phone I showed her (which had the pool voucher code), with a very cold, superior attitude: "Is this the owner?" "This is Songshi Qing Shui, whose is it?" "Do you have the owner's card?"... I knew what she was implying, but honestly, I am very allergic to the term "owner" (which is slang referring to traffic violations for buyers and drivers of motorcycles and cars who do not pay taxes or transfer ownership) - this girl used gangster slang to question me. I am very annoyed for two reasons: (i) in the hotel's voucher, it states that this pool voucher is non-transferable (This certificate is NON TRANSFERABLE) - and there is no so-called "direct from owner." On the other hand, I didn't swim, but let my grandson swim - so can this be considered a "transferable" act? I heard a New Zealander who recently became the General Manager here explain to me in their language whether the two phrases above are synonymous? (ii) For over 20 years, I have bought a membership card at this hotel and used swimming vouchers for my grandson since he was 2 years old; now he is 7 years old - it was normal for 5 years, but today she suddenly questioned me in a "gangster" tone and very uncultured, asking if I was the "owner" (???!!!) - this hotel is hiring increasingly low-quality and uncultured staff - maybe she thinks her salary is paid by the General Manager (?!). In reality, in the end, it was just that I couldn't use the swimming voucher for my grandchild to swim, and it had to pay for the ticket (nearly 500,000) - I didn't "transfer" it, I just let it swim instead of me? It's a minor, it doesn't have the capacity as a contracting party to receive a transfer, or is the "slang" concept that this 5-star staff member is referring to that it must be the "original owner"... -> Such a barbaric treatment from what is called the city's heart center - I think this city doesn't have such a black, unfair, and rude heart! - Please stop this "bait-and-switch" behavior. After the back-and-forth, this staff member Linh called for the manager named Ngân, they called back and forth, and in the end, I wasted almost an hour of time and still had to pay nearly 500,000 VND for my 7-year-old grandchild even though I had a free voucher - because if I didn't swim and brought my grandchild, it would be considered an act of "transferring" a non-"owner" - is this a 5-star hotel, everyone understands? I teach two students, who are currently the Deputy Director of the HCMC Department of Tourism, the governing unit for the large capital of this 5-star hotel - I have never taught them about communication culture and customer bullying in economic management like this. It's a real shame for me, when I thought this was a real 5-star hotel and the foreign General Manager must have brought a lot of civilization to this city, but in reality it was just...?!

Great stay at the Caravelle Hotel
Sep 2025 • Business
I just ended my 4th. stay at the Caravelle Hotel and it was once again a great experince. I visit Ho-Chi-Minh regularly on business trips and I always prefer to Stay at the Caravelle Hotel, due to the excellent business lounge that allows me to relax and get some work done when not at the office. The rooms at the Hotel are nice, big and comofrotable and with the perfect location at the heart of the city center I love the view to the opera house. The service at the hotel is top level with special thans to Mrs. Kim, Ngan, Thy, Nam and Truc.
